findings.title: `--fix` can write through a symlink outside the project root
findings.description: The new `--fix` path passes validator-provided paths directly to `updateFrontmatterField`. The explicit-path filter in `frontmatterFileValidator.ts:52-62` checks containment lexically but does not resolve symlinks, and the default directory scan can also return symlinked `.md` files. A document inside the project tree that links to an external Markdown file can therefore cause `--fix` to modify that external target. Enforce containment on the resolved real path before reading or writing.

findings.title: The “wrong docType” test does not test a mismatch
findings.description: The test titled “a wrong docType literal is still caught” validates `devlog` and `gate-evidence` using those same values, then asserts that an unknown docType produces no findings. It never asserts that a mismatched docType is rejected; in fact, `validateFrontmatter` selects the schema from `data.docType`, so these assertions do not exercise the claimed value-constraint behavior. Either test a context where a mismatch is meant to be detectable, or rename the test and document the intended permissive behavior.
